jobs.title: Implementation Specialist 2, Catholic
jobs.description:
**About the Role**



The Implementation Specialist II will manage the onboarding of customers in all segments by successfully implementing the Pushpay product suite. The right individual provides a distinctive post sale service that makes Pushpay the market leader and preferred choice for digital giving in the non\-profit space. This individual possesses a passion for customer satisfaction, obsession for accuracy, a blend of technical and customer\-interaction skills, a drive for excellence, can effectively navigate objections, and has what it takes to deliver results.

  


*Named as one of BuiltIn '****Best Places to Work****' in Seattle, Denver and Dallas for 2025; ranked number* ***10*** *by Seattle Business Magazine in the '****Washington's 100 Best Companies to Work For'*** *list in the large companies category for 2024; named as a 2025 '****Best Places to Work for Women'*** *by Best Companies Group.*

  


**Benefits and Compensation**



We have a passion for making all employees feel supported. In addition to having a genuine interest in helping you do your best work and drive your career, we offer:


* 100% employer\-paid premiums for Medical HDHP Plan, Dental, and Vision for employee
* 70% employer\-paid premiums for Medical PPO Plan for employees, and Medical, Dental, and Vision for dependents
* 401K match
* Hybrid work model \- 3 days in the COS office / 2 days remote
* Remote work for approved states
* 12 paid company holidays
* 2 paid Volunteer Time Off days
* 15 days PTO to start, increases with tenure and seniority
* Paid parental and adoption leave
* **Compensation Range:** **$67,500\-$78,489**


*Compensation ranges are determined by role and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the pay range for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.*


**The following states are approved as remote work locations for this position: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA \- All other states are not in consideration for this role at this time.**

  


**What You'll Do**


* Project manage the onboarding and implementation of Catholic customers, manage a pipeline, and meet or exceed KPI's.
* Become an expert in the Pushpay product suite and set appropriate expectations with the customer.
* Deliver results, provide high quality customer interactions, drive product adoption, and effectively manage multiple/simultaneous implementations.
* Coordinate with Product, Service Delivery, and Customer Success teams to execute on implementation.
* Build and effectively execute account plans and strategies unique to each account.
* Regularly review assigned accounts to highlight key results, analyze metrics, demonstrate value, and emphasize the ROI, as well as, recommend process/procedure changes to better utilize Pushpay services.
* Help develop existing customer relationships with the company; in\-line with the company service process and ensure maximum customer retention is achieved.
* Maintain knowledge of market conditions and competitive activities.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual goals and provide accurate, timely reports and forecasts as needed for management.
* Receive direction from the VP, Director of Implementation, and guidance from Customer Success Team Leads.

  


**What You'll Bring**


* BA/BS Degree
* 3\+ years of working in SaaS onboarding and implementation, or as a Customer Success Manager.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to identify, critique, suggest, and implement intelligent changes to the clients and business optimization processes.
* Strong problem resolution skills \- proven ability to engage and interact with internal teams to resolve client issues.
* Desire to work in a startup environment, with proactive mindset and minimum need for supervision.
* Experience with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce).
* Ability to prioritize and manage workload to meet deadlines.
* Ability to manage multiple, concurrent client relationships.
* Well\-organized and strong work ethic.
* Ability to anticipate change and adjust priorities accordingly.
* Understanding of key drivers of success for Catholic parishes.
* Understanding of industry culture, products, and services.
* Excellent eye for detail – ability to create accurate and high quality pieces of work.
* Not required: Bilingual in Spanish; ability to translate verbal and written communication, and speak to customers in Spanish.

  



Pushpay is committed to equal opportunity. We value and embrace diversity and inclusion of all Team Members. Pushpay uses E\-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. Head to our career page to learn more.



If you have a disability under the Americans with Disabilities Act or similar law, or you require religious accommodation, and you wish to discuss potential accommodations related to applying for employment at Pushpay, please contact peopleteam@pushpay.com.


**About** **Pushpay**

Pushpay helps organizations and communities come to gather \& stay connected, strengthening community, connection, and belonging through our suite of mobile apps, management software, and giving technology. Our 550 Pushpay teammates support 10,000\+ customers as they drive social good, and we're honored to have processed over $15 billion in charitable giving. We're growing fast, including some exciting acquisitions in recent years, and we need driven talent. Join Pushpay and grow with us!

  



*Applications will be taken on an ongoing basis.*


*\#LI\-TS1 \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-Remote*

jobs.title: Healthcare Recruiter & Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**CareerNation**, a national healthcare staffing firm, is seeking a **Healthcare Recruiter \& Onboarding Specialist** to join our team in a flexible, blended role.


This position combines **healthcare recruiting** with **candidate onboarding and compliance coordination**. It is ideal for someone who is organized, communicative, comfortable working independently, and interested in developing experience in healthcare staffing.

**Entry\-level candidates are welcome to apply. Prior healthcare staffing experience is not required — we will train the right person, and training is paid.**


This is a **variable\-hours position based on current business and staffing needs. Hours and weekly earnings are not guaranteed.**

**Compensation \& Expected Workload**

**Recruiting:** $20/hour

* Approximately **10–20 recruiting hours per week**, depending on business needs
* Paid for authorized recruiting hours worked

**Compliance \& Onboarding:** $25 per completed candidate case

* Paid upon completion of each assigned onboarding/compliance case (drug test, license verification, skills checklist, medical screening, etc)
* Current estimated volume is approximately **10 completed cases per week**
* Cases may include candidates placed through Medely, DNA, HWL, and other CareerNation clients/programs

**Paid training is provided.**


Work volume fluctuates based on open positions, candidate activity, client demand, and placements. **There are no guaranteed minimum hours, number of cases, or weekly earnings.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Healthcare Recruiting**

* Recruit healthcare professionals for temporary, contract, per diem, event, and other staffing opportunities
* Review applications and resumes to identify qualified candidates
* Conduct candidate screening calls and assess qualifications, experience, availability, and interest
* Discuss available assignments, schedules, compensation, and position requirements with candidates
* Source candidates through job boards, applicant databases, referrals, and other recruiting channels
* Maintain regular communication and follow\-up with active candidates
* Present qualified candidates for appropriate openings
* Maintain accurate candidate notes and recruiting activity
* Coordinate with management regarding priority positions and staffing needs
* Assist with job postings and candidate outreach as assigned

**Compliance \& Candidate Onboarding**


Manage assigned candidates from placement/acceptance through completion of their required onboarding and compliance process.


Responsibilities may include:

* Collecting and reviewing professional licenses, certifications, identification, immunization records, and other required documentation
* Coordinating background checks, drug screenings, TB testing, health documents, competency assessments, and other client requirements
* Assisting candidates with completion of required onboarding forms and documentation
* Tracking outstanding requirements and following up with candidates until their files are complete
* Reviewing files for completeness and accuracy before submission
* Maintaining accurate candidate compliance records and trackers
* Uploading or submitting required documentation through applicable client, MSP, VMS, or staffing platforms
* Communicating with candidates regarding missing or expiring requirements
* Escalating compliance issues, delays, or discrepancies when necessary
* Helping ensure candidates are fully cleared before their scheduled start dates

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; college education preferred but **not required**
* **Entry\-level candidates are encouraged to apply**
* Recruiting, customer service, administrative, healthcare, HR, staffing, or credentialing experience is helpful but not required
* Comfortable speaking with candidates by phone, email, and text
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Ability to follow detailed client\-specific processes
* Comfortable learning multiple online systems and staffing platforms
* Ability to manage several candidates and deadlines simultaneously
* Dependable and responsive during agreed\-upon working periods
* Able to work independently in a remote environment

**What We’re Looking For**


We’re looking for someone who can learn quickly, communicate professionally, stay organized, follow a process, and consistently follow through with candidates.


Because this position touches both sides of the staffing process, you’ll learn the full candidate lifecycle — from identifying and screening a healthcare professional through getting that individual fully compliant and ready to work.

**Schedule**

**Flexible, variable schedule based on business needs.**


Recruiting work is currently expected to average approximately **10–20 hours per week**, while onboarding volume is currently estimated at approximately **10 cases per week**. These are estimates only and may increase or decrease substantially.


There are **no guaranteed minimum hours, cases, or compensation.**

**Why Join CareerNation?**

* **Paid training**
* Entry\-level candidates welcome
* Flexible working hours
* Remote work
* Gain hands\-on healthcare recruiting and credentialing experience
* Learn the full healthcare staffing lifecycle
* Performance\-based opportunity for additional responsibility and growth

**Job Type:** Part\-time / Variable Hours  

**Location:** Remote  

**Recruiting Compensation:** $20/hour  

**Compliance/Onboarding Compensation:** $25 per completed case  

**Expected Recruiting Hours:** Approximately 10–20/week, variable  

**Estimated Compliance Volume:** Approximately 10 cases/week, variable

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Architect (100% Remote w/ some Travel)
Implementation Specialist II - RCM- Salt Lake City, Utah
jobs.description:
Kipu is bettering the behavioral health landscape, helping treatment centers achieve the best outcomes and empowering patients and caregivers on every step of the recovery journey. Join us in our work to advance behavioral health care in our communities. Our innovative solutions support providers in treating addiction, eating disorders, and many other behavioral health conditions. Our EMR, CRM, and revenue cycle solutions help behavioral health facilities succeed in managing their patients' entire care journey, but it is through our people that we truly make a difference.

**Role Overview**


The Implementation Specialist II, RCM independently owns end\-to\-end implementations for behavioral health treatment centers on the Kipu RCM platform. You will lead discovery, translate billing and revenue cycle requirements into configuration decisions, train end users, and drive accountability for timelines and deliverables. This role operates with minimal oversight and contributes to team quality through mentorship and process improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Discovery \& Solution Design**

* Lead discovery conversations to identify client billing workflows, payer mix, compliance requirements, and constraints.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable RCM configuration decisions aligned with best practices.
* Challenge misaligned or risky requests respectfully, explaining tradeoffs and downstream billing impacts.

**Configuration \& Data Quality**

* Configure billing workflows, payer rules, fee schedules, and system settings accurately on the first pass.
* Troubleshoot RCM configuration issues by identifying root causes rather than treating symptoms.
* Validate billing data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before go\-live.

**Client Training \& Adoption**

* Deliver structured, goal\-oriented training that prepares clients to manage billing workflows independently.
* Equip client administrators to train their own teams on billing processes and system usage.
* Drive client accountability for tasks, timelines, and data deliverables.

**Project Delivery \& Risk Management**

* Own project documentation, ensuring records and project plans reflect reality.
* Identify risks early and document them with clear descriptions, owners, and mitigation plans.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional partners when scope, risk, or complexity warrants it.

**Go\-Live Readiness \& Adoption**

* Prepare clients for go\-live by validating that all billing readiness criteria are genuinely met.
* Support post\-go\-live adoption by tracking billing accuracy, claim submission rates, and early revenue cycle health.
* Contribute to process improvements and share learnings with peers and newer team members.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2\-4 years of experience implementing an RCM system, or a combination of RCM implementation and technical support.
* 6\+ years of revenue cycle management experience.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to lead structured client meetings and drive decisions.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing timelines.

**Preferred**

* Experience in behavioral health, mental health, or addiction treatment settings.
* Familiarity with EDI, ERA, clearinghouse processes, and payer enrollment workflows.
* Experience mentoring or supporting newer team members.

**Benefits \& Compensation**

* Flexible paid time off.
* 11 Paid Holidays.
* Health, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance.
* Parental Leave.
* Pet Insurance.
* 401(K) with Company Match.

**Kipu Promise**


In an environment of rapid change, millions are struggling to cope. Kipu is here to help. Having shaped the industry for 10 years, today we focus on advancing our New Vision for the behavioral health ecosystem, evolving how it operates, interacts, communicates, and heals.


We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, gender identity, or disability status.

jobs.title: RN - Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:
***RN \- Implementation Specialist***

**Job Summary:**


Responsible for applications training, electronic health records (EHR) training, onsite support for staff and provider use of hospital\-based clinical information systems. Onsite support includes initial clinical systems training and ongoing support. This position supports hospital’s strategic use of data to improve clinical, operational, financial and quality outcomes. It serves as a bridge between information technology, clinical operations and leadership by managing data conversion projects, developing reports and dashboards, conducting data analysis and supporting EHR optimization initiatives.

**Essential Functions:**

* Provides initial and ongoing training to providers and staff on hospital applications, including EMR
* Collects input from care providers required for design and development of clinical information systems and collaborates in the design, build, analysis and improvement of clinical information systems
* Assists with data transfer assignments between the hospital and other entities.
* Assists with data mining and queries to write reports or data extractions to support all departments. Assignment includes the development and maintenance of departmental dashboards
* Ensure that the hospital achieves Meaningful Use targets, including communicating to relevant departments their progress in achieving Meaningful Use goals and assisting with the process to achieve the goals
* Participates in organization committees to share information about clinical user practices, needs and requirements. Facilitate communication with other support staff to respond to questions or provide additional support to care providers
* Communicates changes and/or new information, including EHR upgrades, in a timely and appropriate manner
* Work collaboratively with the other IT staff, providing limited technical support to clinical users and facilitate communication with technical resources when more advanced technical assistance is required.
* Prepares reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Tableau and other tools.
* Conduct clinical system demonstrations as requested by organizational committees
* Enhance clinical user satisfaction by developing expanded and coordinated approaches to service delivery to care providers.
* Support application implementation, troubleshooting, and day\-to\-day system support activities.


All job requirements listed indicate the minimum level of knowledge, skills and ability deemed necessary to perform the job proficiently. This job description is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Employees will be required to perform other job\-related instructions given by their supervisor, subject to reasonable accommodation.

**Hours:** Full\-Time, Monday \- Friday.

**Salary:** Base salary of $42\.00 \- $43\.00 per hour. Additional increases based on preferred degrees.

**Company Overview:** Ellenville Regional Hospital is a non\-profit, community focused hospital based in New York’s Hudson Valley. We support our local community with health, wellness, specialty services and readily available diagnostic testing. We are centrally located for residents in surrounding areas to access our subacute rehabilitation programs, specialists and ambulatory services. Our healthcare is delivered with compassion and respect based on our commitment to improving our community health through excellence, innovation and state\-of\-the\-art technologies.

* Medical Benefits

	+ Vision
* Life Insurance – Employer Sponsored, Supplemental Life Insurance
* PTO
	+ Vacation Time
	+ Sick Time
	+ Paid Holidays

* Employee Assistance Program
* Tuition Assistance
* Discount Program
* Virtual fitness, mindfulness and nutrition app
* Healthcare Concierge Service
* MetLife Legal Plan
* LifeLock Identity Protection
* Nationwide Pet Insurance

**This is an in\-person, on\-site position and is not eligible for remote or hybrid work.**


Requirements:
**Experience:**

**Required:**

* Minimum of 2 years of healthcare or clinical informatics experience
* Hands\-on experience with EHR such as Meditech, AthenaOne, or similar platforms
* Understanding of healthcare workflows (inpatient, ambulatory, ancillary services such as Radiology, Rehabilitation services etc.)
* Hands\-on experience with visual analytics tools such as Tableau
* Experience as a super user for clinical systems supporting clinical users (physicians, nurses, allied health professionals, etc.)

**Job Description:**


Job Description
Qualifacts is a leading provider of behavioral health software and SaaS solutions for clinical productivity, compliance and state reporting, billing, and business intelligence. Its mission is to be an innovative and trusted technology and end\-to\-end solutions partner, enabling exceptional outcomes for its customers and those they serve. Qualifacts’ comprehensive portfolio, including the CareLogic®, Credible™, and InSync® platforms, spans and serves the entire behavioral health, rehabilitative, and human services market supporting non\-profit Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics (CCBHC) as well as for\-profit large enterprise and small business providers. Qualifacts has a loyal customer base, with more than 2,500 customers representing 75,000 providers serving more than 6 million patients. Qualifacts was recognized in the 2022 and 2023 Best in KLAS: Software and Services report as having the top ranked Behavioral Health EHR solutions.


If you want to work inside an atmosphere where innovation has purpose, and your ambition works to support our customers and those they serve, please apply today!

**We are seeking candidates in Nashville or Tampa to work a hybrid schedule in either office location. Remote candidates will not be considered.**

**Summary of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**


We are seeking a Clinical Implementation Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in guiding new customers through the entire implementation lifecycle of our healthcare technology solutions. This position requires a blend of clinical expertise, technical knowledge, and exceptional communication skills to ensure successful adoption and compliance with state and reporting requirements.

**Responsibilities for the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Assess clinical practices, state reporting, and patient treatment requirements; develop collaborative solutions and present recommendations
* Lead new customer implementations from kickoff through go\-live, ensuring a smooth and efficient process
* Resolve client inquiries promptly, maintaining ownership through resolution
* Maintain project documentation and communicate updates via agendas, minutes, and project management tools
* Build and sustain positive, productive relationships with customers and internal teams
* Apply consultative techniques to identify configuration requirements and implement best practices
* Review and validate software configurations with customer implementation teams
* Ensure quality of configured features and prepare customers for effective end\-user training
* Complete product training and demonstrate adaptability across multiple EHR platforms
* Creatively resolve and assess a wide range of issues, suggesting alternative approaches as needed
* Document and track all customer state and reporting requirements to ensure compliance
* Record all customer interactions in CRM according to established standards
* Participate in on\-site visits as needed to gather data and understand workflows

**Qualifications of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* Clinical experience in behavioral health or general healthcare
* SaaS/cloud implementation experience; EHR/EMR experience preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities of the Clinical Implementation Specialist**

* Strong remote collaboration skills
* Data visualization and reporting analysis expertise
* Familiarity with CCBHC and state\-specific clinical requirements (NY or CA preferred)
* Knowledge of HIPAA compliance
* Exceptional customer service and communication skills (written \& oral)
* Quick, logical problem\-solving with attention to detail and follow\-through
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to travel up to 25%

Qualifacts is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Implementation Specialist**
=============================

**About the Role**
------------------


Prospyr is looking for an **Implementation Specialist** to help new customers successfully transition onto Prospyr and get their teams operational as quickly and confidently as possible.


You’ll own the implementation process from post\-sale handoff through go\-live, coordinating configuration, data migration, workflows, training, and launch readiness.


This role is highly project\-oriented. You'll manage multiple implementations simultaneously while working closely with customers and internal teams to keep projects organized, remove blockers, and ensure customers are prepared to operate successfully in Prospyr.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Implementation Project Management**

* Own customer implementations from Sales handoff through successful go\-live.
* Build and manage implementation plans, milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.
* Coordinate customer and internal stakeholders throughout the project.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and blockers early and drive them toward resolution.
* Maintain clear communication around project status and next steps.

### **Platform Configuration**

* Guide customers through configuration of their Prospyr environment.
* Help customers translate existing operational workflows into Prospyr.
* Coordinate setup across areas such as:


	+ Providers and staff
	+ Locations
	+ Scheduling
	+ Services and catalog
	+ Forms and consents
	+ Payments
	+ Patient communications
	+ Inventory
	+ Memberships
	+ Online booking
	+ Integrations and other applicable features
* Validate configuration prior to go\-live.

### **Data Migration \& Integrations**

* Coordinate data migration requirements between customers and internal technical teams.
* Help customers understand what data is required and how it should be prepared.
* Track migration progress and validate readiness with the customer.
* Coordinate third\-party integrations and dependencies when applicable.
* Escalate technical blockers with clear documentation and business impact.

### **Training \& Go\-Live Readiness**

* Coordinate and deliver role\-based customer training.
* Ensure administrators, providers, front\-desk teams, and other users understand the workflows relevant to their roles.
* Develop a clear go\-live readiness checklist for each implementation.
* Identify knowledge gaps before launch and coordinate additional training where needed.
* Provide additional support during the transition into live operations.

### **Process Improvement**

* Identify recurring implementation friction and opportunities to improve Prospyr's onboarding process.
* Help develop implementation templates, playbooks, checklists, documentation, and training resources.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring implementation blockers.
* Help move repeatable onboarding activities toward scalable self\-service experiences.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Customers launch on time with minimal disruption to their businesses.
* Implementation timelines and responsibilities are clear to customers and internal teams.
* Data migration and configuration issues are identified before go\-live.
* Customers enter ongoing CX management with strong platform knowledge and clearly defined workflows.
* Time\-to\-value and time\-to\-go\-live improve as implementation processes become more standardized.
* Fewer post\-launch support issues originate from incomplete configuration or training.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 2–4\+ years of SaaS implementation, onboarding, project management, or customer success experience.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple customer implementations simultaneously.
* Comfortable learning complex software and becoming highly proficient in product configuration.
* Strong customer communication and training skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot problems and coordinate effectively with technical teams.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where processes continue to evolve.
* Healthcare, EMR, medical aesthetics, wellness, payments, or vertical SaaS experience is a plus.

**Role Philosophy**
-------------------


Implementation owns the question:

**“What needs to happen to get this customer successfully live on Prospyr?”**


The Implementation Specialist drives that process from beginning to end, while creating a clean transition to the CXM who will own the customer's long\-term success.

jobs.title: EHR Clin Apps Analyst - ITS-Innovation & AI
jobs.description:
**Minimum Qualifications:**


Bachelor’s degree in a related field and one (1\) year of related experience. Must possess sufficient educational background and/or experience to perform clinical applications analysis or programming. An equivalent combination of education and experience relevant to the role may be considered for this position.

  



**Preferred Qualifications:**


Having participated in a relevant fellowship program and/or one (1\) year of IS experience.

  



**Job Summary:**


This position is responsible for the design, configuration, implementation, maintenance, and support of clinical applications of basic to medium complexity. Clinical applications include any software application used in support of the clinical enterprise, including patient registration, patient billing, clinical documentation utilized in the ambulatory and inpatient settings, as well as applications for specific medical specialties such as, but not limited to, Radiology, Pathology, Oncology, Transplant, and Cardiology. Other responsibilities include providing basic to intermediate analysis and documentation of business and management problems to formulate clinical application requirements. Assists in providing solutions to routine problems utilizing more efficient operational procedures, workflows, and technology solutions.

 **Job Duties:**


An entry\-level Medical Device Integration (MDI) position plays a crucial role in ensuring seamless data flow between medical devices and our Epic EMR. This position involves assisting with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of integration engines (Capsule) and device interfaces.

 **Key duties include:**

* Troubleshooting connectivity issues
* Performing routine system checks
* Documenting integration processes
* Collaborating with clinical and IT teams to optimize device data capture, ultimately enhancing patient care and operational efficiency

 **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**


For this role, candidates should possess foundational knowledge of healthcare IT systems, network protocols, and medical device terminology. Essential skills include strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail for configuration and troubleshooting, and effective communication for collaborating with diverse teams. Additionally, the position requires the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently and the physical capacity to lift up to 50 lbs, which is often necessary for handling equipment.

 **Salary Range:**


Actual salary commensurate with experience.

 **Work Schedule:**


Partial Remote, onsite as needed. Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm, and as needed on occasion.
